consolidate_spans: consolidate overlapping character spans in a caption into clean word-aligned spans
get_root_and_nouns: extract root noun phrase and negative noun spans from a sentence using spaCy NLP
normalize_sentence: normalize a sentence by removing punctuation, stopwords, and normalizing whitespace
span_intersect_span: check whether two character spans overlap in a text string
spanlist_intersect_spanlist: check whether any span in one list intersects with any span in another list
